channel.title: The Diary Of A CEO with Steven Bartlett
channel.description:
Welcome to The Diary Of A CEO where you'll find raw, human conversations with the world’s most fascinating experts, storytellers, thinkers and business leaders.
Hosted by Steven Bartlett (entrepreneur, investor, author, and founder of Steven.com and Flight Fund) this channel was created with a simple mission: to share personal lessons that help both you live better, more fulfilling lives.
What is DOAC? Beyond Diary Of A CEO, the acronym reflects our core ethos:
- Dreamers — Dream boldly. - Open-minded — Think without limits. - Awareness — Expand your perspective. - Connection — Feel more connected.
This is your corner of the internet to dream boldly, think openly, expand your awareness, and feel more connected.
